message.content:
On guidance, management now expects fourth quarter revenue of $1.93 billion to $1.95 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.34 to $3.40 [N] [D1]. The release before guided the third quarter alone, so the newest outlook carries the guidance a quarter forward and above where the release before set it [D2].

What is working, the release says, is the company's strategy and portfolio, whose "growing relevance" it credits for the quarter's record results [D1]. It reports growth in its industrial group "across the semiconductor, general electronics and automotive and energy markets" [D1]. Management says it remains "confident in our ability to sustain our momentum and deliver long-term value creation" [D1].

What is not working, the newest release names nothing going badly in the quarter, and among the risks it lists are "tariff and trade policy impacts and order cancellations" [D1].
